contexts.title: Nonprofit CRM
contexts.definition: Records a nonprofit, association or membership organization keeps about its constituents: contacts, gifts and recurring gifts, logged interactions, relationships between contacts, lists and segments, and memberships. Generic to any constituent relationship management system.

concepts.definition: A person, organization or household that a nonprofit or association keeps one record for in its relationship database, whatever its roles (donor, member, volunteer, participant, vendor), with names, contact channels, communication preferences and do-not-contact flags.

fields.name: externalIdentifier
fields.description: Unique id from another system (legacy database, website user, payment platform).

fields.name: contactSubType
fields.description: Site-defined subtypes, e.g. Student, Staff, Sponsor, Funder.

fields.name: prefix
fields.description: Ms., Mr., Dr. …

fields.name: legalIdentifier
fields.description: SSN, EIN/TIN or other legal id.

fields.name: employer
fields.description: The organization constituent this individual works for.

fields.name: isDeceased
fields.description: Deceased (individual) or closed (organization).

fields.name: emailOnHold
fields.description: Address is bouncing or held.

fields.name: preferredCommunicationMethod
fields.description: Any of Phone, Email, Postal Mail, SMS, Fax.

fields.name: doNotTrade
fields.description: Do not share or sell this contact's details.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the record came from: import, web form, event registration.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Labels applied to the record.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from CiviCRM core 6.19.0 schema (Contact, Email, Phone, Address, Website, Tag.entityType.php). Contact carries contact_type Individual/Organization/Household (Individual-only: names, gender, birth date; Organization: organization_name, legal_name, sic_code; Household: household_name). Email/Phone/Address/Website are child rows; the primary one of each is folded in. Consent flags do_not_* and is_opt_out kept. schema.org Person/Organization and FOAF Agent share the name, email, telephone, address and url fields.

concepts.definition: A gift of money, goods or services that an organization receives from a person or organization without giving back anything of equal value, recorded with its amount, date received, fund or financial type, payment method, campaign, receipting and any tribute such as in honor or in memory of someone.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total amount given; market value for in-kind gifts.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: financialType
fields.description: Fund or revenue category, e.g. Donation, Member Dues, Event Fee, Campaign Contribution; decides tax deductibility.

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Credit card, check, cash, EFT, in-kind …

fields.name: campaign
fields.description: Appeal or campaign the gift responded to.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the gift came from: donation page, import, phonebank.

fields.name: nonDeductibleAmount
fields.description: Portion not tax deductible (value of goods or services received).

fields.name: feeAmount
fields.description: Payment processor fee.

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: Processor or bank transaction id.

fields.name: receiptDate
fields.description: When the tax receipt was sent.

fields.name: thankYouDate
fields.description: When the donor was thanked.

fields.name: recurringDonation
fields.description: The standing commitment this installment belongs to, if any.

fields.name: tributeHonoree
fields.description: Person or organization the gift honors or memorializes.

fields.name: softCreditContact
fields.description: Someone credited for the gift without being the payer (solicitor, workplace giving, personal fundraiser).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-text memo about the gift.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: CiviCRM core 6.19.0 Contribution (contact_id, total_amount, currency, receive_date, financial_type_id, payment_instrument_id, contribution_status_id, campaign_id, source, non_deductible_amount, fee_amount, net_amount, tax_amount, trxn_id, invoice_number, check_number, receipt_date, thankyou_date, cancel_date/reason, contribution_recur_id) and ContributionSoft (soft_credit_type in_honor_of/in_memory_of/solicited). Cross-checked against the Open Collective GraphQL API v2 Order type (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencollective/opencollective-frontend/main/lib/graphql/schemaV2.graphql: fromAccount, toAccount, amount, totalAmount, taxAmount, paymentProcessorFee, status, frequency, paymentMethod, processedAt, description, memo, tags) and schema.org DonateAction (agent, recipient, price, priceCurrency). Not 360Giving: that standard describes grants a funder awards, not gifts an organization receives (see grantmaking/grant-award).

concepts.definition: A donor's standing authorization to give a set amount at a regular interval (monthly, yearly) until cancelled or a number of installments is reached; each successful charge creates a separate gift record. It carries the schedule, next charge date, failure count and the processor's subscription reference.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount collected each installment.

fields.name: frequencyInterval
fields.description: Number of units between installments (1 month, 3 months).

fields.name: installments
fields.description: Total installments; empty or 0 for open-ended.

fields.name: cycleDay
fields.description: Day of the period the charge is made.

fields.name: failureCount
fields.description: Failed charge attempts since the last success.

fields.name: processorReference
fields.description: Subscription id at the payment processor.

fields.name: emailReceipt
fields.description: Send a receipt after each installment.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: CiviCRM core 6.19.0 ContributionRecur (amount, currency, frequency_unit, frequency_interval, installments, cycle_day, start_date, end_date, next_sched_contribution_date, contribution_status_id, cancel_date/reason, failure_count, failure_retry_date, processor_id, auto_renew, is_email_receipt); Open Collective API v2 Order with frequency MONTHLY/YEARLY, nextChargeDate, lastChargedAt, status (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencollective/opencollective-frontend/main/lib/graphql/schemaV2.graphql). Kept separate from Donation because both models store the commitment as its own record, with its own status and lifecycle, that spawns one gift per installment.

concepts.definition: A logged interaction or task involving one or more people an organization keeps records on, such as a phone call, meeting, email, follow-up or tour, with its type, date, duration, status, medium and the contacts who did it, were its subject, or are assigned to it.

fields.name: activityType
fields.description: Meeting, Phone Call, Email, SMS, Follow up, Tour, Contribution, Event Registration, or site-defined types.

fields.name: details
fields.description: Notes, agenda or message body.

fields.name: sourceContact
fields.description: Who logged or performed it.

fields.name: targetContacts
fields.description: Who it was with or about.

fields.name: assigneeContacts
fields.description: Who must do it (tasks, follow-ups).

fields.name: parentActivity
fields.description: Activity this is a follow-up of.

fields.name: sourceRecord
fields.description: Id of the record (gift, membership, registration) that generated it.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from CiviCRM core 6.19.0 schema (Activity, ActivityContact.entityType.php). ActivityContact.record_type_id gives each linked contact's role: Activity Source, Activity Targets, Activity Assignees. schema.org InteractAction/CommunicateAction (agent, participant, recipient, startTime, endTime, instrument, location) cover the same ground.

concepts.definition: A typed, dated, two-way link between two people or organizations in a relationship database, read one way from the first party and the other way from the second: employee of / employer of, spouse of, parent of / child of, board member of, volunteer for.

fields.name: relationshipType
fields.description: Machine name of the A-to-B direction, e.g. Employee of, Spouse of, Head of Household for.

fields.name: labelAToB
fields.description: How A relates to B, e.g. Employee of.

fields.name: labelBToA
fields.description: How B relates to A, e.g. Employer of.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from CiviCRM core 6.19.0 schema (Relationship, RelationshipType.entityType.php). Relationship (contact_id_a, contact_id_b, relationship_type_id, start_date, end_date, is_active, description) with RelationshipType (name_a_b, label_a_b, label_b_a, contact_type_a/b). schema.org Role/OrganizationRole adds startDate, endDate and roleName to a link the same way.

concepts.definition: A named set of people and organizations kept in a relationship database, either listed by hand or computed from a saved search, used as a mailing list, access-control group or segment for outreach, with each member's added, removed or pending status.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Machine name.

fields.name: groupType
fields.description: Any of Access Control, Mailing List.

fields.name: isSmartGroup
fields.description: Membership computed from a saved search rather than listed.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Module or process that created it.

fields.name: memberContact
fields.description: A member (one row per member in the membership list).

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from CiviCRM core 6.19.0 schema (Group, GroupContact.entityType.php). Group (name, title, description, frontend_title, frontend_description, group_type, saved_search_id, visibility, parents, is_active, is_hidden, source, created_id) and GroupContact (group_id, contact_id, status Added/Removed/Pending).

concepts.definition: A person's or organization's paid or complimentary standing as a member of an association, society or nonprofit, of a given type and status, with join date, current period start and end, renewal terms and where it came from. Generic to any membership body; access to a shop or facility is not implied.

fields.name: membershipOrganization
fields.description: The organization the membership is in.

fields.name: membershipType
fields.description: e.g. Individual, Family, Student, Organizational, Lifetime.

fields.name: isCurrent
fields.description: Status counts as a current member.

fields.name: joinDate
fields.description: Start of the first membership period (member since).

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start of the current unbroken period.

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: When the current period expires; renewal moves it.

fields.name: statusOverridden
fields.description: Status set by hand instead of computed from dates.

fields.name: primaryMembership
fields.description: Membership this one is inherited from (family or employee memberships).

fields.name: recurringDonation
fields.description: Recurring payment that renews it.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from CiviCRM core 6.19.0 schema (Membership, MembershipType, MembershipStatus.entityType.php). Membership (contact_id, membership_type_id, join_date, start_date, end_date, source, status_id, is_override, status_override_end_date, owner_membership_id, contribution_recur_id, campaign_id) with MembershipType (member_of_contact_id, minimum_fee, duration_unit, duration_interval, period_type, auto_renew) and MembershipStatus (name, is_current_member). schema.org ProgramMembership (member, hostingOrganization, programName, membershipNumber) is the same shape. Distinct from makerspace-operations/member, which adds access cards, waivers and facility access.
